title: NFL Football
description:
Kansas City Chiefs at Miami Dolphins
The Dolphins (0-2) host the Chiefs (2-0) in NFL Week 3 at Hard Rock Stadium. Miami enters last in the AFC East after a 35-13 loss to San Francisco. Unbeaten Kansas City edged Indianapolis 33-30 in OT and has won five straight against Miami.

title: NFL Football
description:
